vocabulary.definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果
降低目标护甲
让普通攻击附带额外效果：减甲、减速、减疗、烧蓝、额外伤害、中毒、降低属性等；有概率触发或只强化下一次攻击也算。单纯提高攻击力、攻速，以及吸血、暴击、分裂弹射归各自词条
使敌方单位的攻击有概率落空
说明明确写打断持续施法；眩晕、沉默等已有控制不重复记
技能或物品用一次消耗一点；只决定数值或层数的不算
攻击伤害波及周围单位
吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）
受到攻击或伤害时触发的反击伤害：按比例返还所受伤害、固定值反击，或受伤触发的范围伤害（如半人马·反伤、斧王·反击螺旋、钢毛后背）；攻击者不一定被打到也算，记条件
在一段时间内不会被打死（如薄葬、回光返照）
处于减益免疫（技能免疫）时，只有能穿透减益免疫的效果才对其生效（如碎颅锤的重击可以眩晕开了黑皇杖的单位）
目标无法普通攻击
拉、推、交换、投掷其他单位（如动人之舐、移形换位）
目标低于生命阈值时直接杀死
提供目标或区域的视野
恢复生命值（治疗、生命恢复），含属性生命恢复（如治疗指环+4.5）
让目标受到更多物理伤害或全部伤害（只加深魔法的归上一项）
攻击或技能恢复自身生命：按造成的伤害、按目标生命或每次攻击固定值（攻击吸血、技能吸血、如噬魂鬼·盛宴、附魂面具）
为自己恢复或从其他单位抽取法力（如莱恩法力吸取），含属性回蓝和回蓝倍率；对友军生效且能给自己回蓝的也算
阻止目标闪烁、传送或离开范围；只是不能走的归定身
使隐身单位显形，不等于持续真视
闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
降低移动速度或攻击速度
降低自身受到的减速效果（如散夜对剑+30%）
使指向自身或队友的技能失效
把指向技能反弹给施法者
夺取目标的属性
使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
能摧毁树木
能穿过树木移动

objects.subject: slark_pounce
objects.description_zh: 斯拉克向前跳跃，束缚第一个碰到的英雄并施加能量转移的叠加效果。该单位只能在斯拉克着地点附近的有限范围内移动。
objects.description_en: Slark leaps forward, leashing and applying Essence Shift stacks to the first hero he connects. That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.
notes_zh: 施放后斯拉克以%pounce_speed%的速度向前跳跃，抓住敌方英雄或跳跃%pounce_distance%距离后停下。
不能束缚减益免疫单位。
斯拉克落地点附近的树木将会被摧毁。

scepter.zh: 变为充能型技能，并且提升距离。

objects.subject: slark_saltwater_shiv
objects.description_zh: 斯拉克用他的海浪短刀划开目标，窃取目标一部分的移动速度、生命恢复和生命回复。这个效果独立叠加。
objects.description_en: Slark slices the target with his salty shiv, stealing a portion of the target's movement speed, Health Regen and Health Restoration.These effects stack independently.

objects.subject: slark_essence_shift
objects.description_zh: 斯拉克的攻击会偷走敌方英雄的生命能量，每次吸取他们的%stat_loss%点全属性并转化成自身额外%agi_gain%点敏捷值。只要敌方英雄带着该效果在斯拉克300范围内阵亡，他将永久窃取%stat_loss%点敏捷。
objects.description_en: Slark steals the life essence of enemy heroes with his attacks, draining %stat_loss% of each of their attributes and converting them to bonus %agi_gain% Agility. If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals %stat_loss% Agility.
notes_zh: 属性值最少为1点。
斯拉克或受到作用的单位死亡后，阵亡单位因能量转移变化的属性值将回归正常。但是两方的属性值相互独立，并无关联。
斯拉克无需完成击杀就能永久窃取敏捷，只要敌方英雄身上拥有能量转移状态时在斯拉克的窃取范围内阵亡即可。
破坏会使技能无法获得临时的叠加效果。依然可以获得永久的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

objects.subject: slark_shadow_dance
objects.description_zh: 当斯拉克不处于敌方视野内时，他会被动获得移动速度加成和生命恢复。如果受到来自中立单位的伤害，%neutral_disable%秒内会失去被动移速和生命恢复加成。主动开启后，斯拉克将自己藏进暗影之云，变成隐身状态，不会被反隐手段发现。攻击、施法、使用物品都不会使斯拉克显形，但是敌人可以看见暗影之云。
objects.description_en: When not visible to the enemy team, Slark passively gains bonus movement speed and health regeneration.  If Slark is damaged by a neutral unit, the passive movement and health regeneration bonuses are lost for %neutral_disable% seconds.When activated, Slark hides himself in a cloud of shadows, becoming immune to detection. Attacking, casting spells, and using items will not reveal Slark, but enemies can see the cloud itself.

objects.subject: medusa_split_shot
objects.description_zh: 美杜莎施展魔法将她的箭分裂成若干支箭矢。分裂箭造成的伤害为正常攻击力的一定百分比。额外目标不会受到其他攻击特效（比如致命一击）的作用。
objects.description_en: Medusa magically splits her shot into several arrows. These arrows deal a lower percent of her normal damage.The extra targets will not receive other attack effects (such as critical strike).
notes_zh: 次级目标将是除了主要目标外距离最近的敌方单位。
如果在分裂箭激活的状态下创造幻象，幻象也将继承此技能。

scepter.zh: 使分裂箭的次级攻击也能继承攻击特效，并且目标数量提升。
scepter.en: Allows on-hit effects to apply to the secondary attacks from Split Shot. Increases arrow count.

objects.subject: medusa_mystic_snake
objects.description_zh: 放出一条秘术异蛇在敌人之间跳跃，造成伤害。每次跳跃后伤害和速度都会增加。抵达最后一个目标后，它会返回到美杜莎身上为其恢复魔法值。异蛇会返还所有目标最大魔法值一定百分比的魔法。
objects.description_en: A mystic snake made of energy jumps from target to target dealing damage. Damage and speed increases with each jump. After it reaches its last target, it returns to Medusa to replenish her with mana. The snake returns a percentage of the targets' total mana.
notes_zh: 秘术异蛇无法躲避。

objects.subject: medusa_gorgon_grasp
objects.description_zh: 美杜莎沿着一条直线射出%volley_count%组箭矢，每组的作用范围递增。齐射的箭矢击中的敌人会受到初始爆发伤害，然后被缠绕且无法转身，并对敌人可见，同时受到每秒伤害。
objects.description_en: Medusa fires arrows in a line that land in %volley_count% groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second.

objects.subject: medusa_mana_shield
objects.description_zh: 创造一个魔法护盾，消耗美杜莎的魔法值以吸收%absorption_pct%%%的伤害。幻象的伤害吸收系数减少%illusion_percentage%%%。
objects.description_en: Creates a shield that absorbs %absorption_pct%%% of incoming damage in exchange for Medusa's mana. Illusions absorb %illusion_percentage%%% less damage per point of mana.
notes_zh: 伤害的吸收先于任何伤害减免机制，所以提高物理护甲，物理格挡和魔法抗性都不能减少吸收相同伤害所需的魔法。

objects.subject: medusa_stone_gaze
objects.description_zh: 任何盯着蛇发女妖的敌方单位的攻击速度和移动速度均将被减缓。如果一单位在石化凝视期间盯着蛇发女妖超过%face_duration%秒，该单位会被完全石化。被石化的单位处于眩晕状态，受到物理攻击时承受额外伤害。
objects.description_en: Any enemy units looking at Medusa will have their movement and attack speed slowed.  If %face_duration% seconds of total time is accumulated looking at Medusa while Stone Gaze is active, that unit will turn to stone.  Petrified units are stunned, and take bonus physical attack damage.
notes_zh: 无论敌方单位是在美杜莎施放技能期间的何时受到石化凝视作用，他受到的技能效果都是满额的持续时间。

objects.subject: troll_warlord_whirling_axes_ranged
objects.name_zh: 巨魔战将·旋风飞斧（远程）
objects.description_zh: 巨魔战将掷出手中的五把飞斧，减速并伤害前方%axe_range%范围锥形区域内的敌方单位。
objects.description_en: Troll hurls a fistful of five axes in a cone shape over %axe_range% range, slowing and damaging enemy units.
notes_zh: 无法作用于肉山。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

scepter.zh: 旋风飞斧（远程）可以驱散敌人。降低冷却时间和魔法消耗。驱散类型：弱驱散
scepter.en: Causes Whirling Axes (Ranged) to dispel enemies. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

objects.subject: troll_warlord_whirling_axes_melee
objects.name_zh: 巨魔战将·旋风飞斧（近战）
objects.description_zh: 巨魔战将掷出两把飞斧环绕在他周围，使敌方单位受到伤害，并且部分普通攻击将不能命中。
objects.description_en: Troll hurls two axes around him in a close range area of effect, damaging enemy units and causing them to miss some attacks.
notes_zh: 无法作用于肉山。

scepter.zh: 旋风飞斧（近战）可以驱散自己。降低冷却时间和魔法消耗。驱散类型：弱驱散
scepter.en: Causes Whirling Axes (Melee) to dispel Troll Warlord. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

objects.subject: troll_warlord_fervor
objects.description_zh: 当巨魔战将持续攻击同一个目标时，他会攻击得越来越快。如果改变目标，则额外的攻速加成清零。
objects.description_en: With each continuous blow on the same target, Troll gains increased attack speed.  If Troll changes targets, the stacks drop to zero.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏会使阿哈利姆魔晶的几率触发失效。

shard.zh: 巨魔战将在攻击敌方单位时拥有%base_chance%%% + 热血战魂叠加次数*%extra_attack_chance_per_stack%%%的几率对远程攻击距离 + %range_buffer%范围内任意单位发动一次额外的远程攻击。
shard.en: Grants Troll %base_chance%%% + %extra_attack_chance_per_stack%%% chance per Fervor stack of firing an additional ranged attack to any unit within its ranged attack range plus %range_buffer% when attacking an enemy unit.

objects.subject: troll_warlord_berserkers_rage
objects.description_zh: 近战形态下巨魔战将的攻击有几率触发诱捕，阻止目标移动或使用位移类技能。另外近战形态下还拥有额外移动速度。远程形态下巨魔战将的攻击有几率使目标残废，造成额外伤害，并且降低目标的移动和攻击速度。
objects.description_en: While in melee form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to ensnare, preventing the target from moving or using mobility spells and has additional movement speed.When in ranged form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to Maim the target, dealing bonus damage, and slowing the target's movement and attack speed.

objects.subject: troll_warlord_battle_trance
objects.description_zh:
巨魔战将释放出强大的战斗专注，强迫自身持续攻击%range%距离内最近的敌方单位，以英雄优先。专注期间不会因伤害而阵亡。提供额外吸血，攻击速度，减速抗性和移动速度。施放时施加弱驱散。 

驱散类型：弱驱散
objects.description_en:
Troll unleashes a powerful battle trance, that forces you to continuously attack the closest enemy unit within %range% range, prioritizing heroes. Damage does not kill you during this mode. Grants you bonus lifesteal, attack speed, slow resistance and movement speed. Applies a Basic Dispel.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 巨魔战将在战斗专注作用下仍然可以使用他的物品技能，但是无法执行其他指令。
斧王的淘汰之刃还是能斩杀巨魔战将。
巨魔战将会获得目标的视野。

objects.subject: centaur_hoof_stomp
objects.name_zh: 半人马战行者·马蹄践踏
objects.description_zh: 经过短暂的蓄力后，半人马战行者猛踏地面，眩晕并伤害身边的敌方单位。在延迟期间，他被缴械，但可以移动。
objects.description_en: After a brief windup, Centaur Warrunner slams the ground, stunning and damaging nearby enemy units. During the delay, he is disarmed but can move.

objects.subject: centaur_double_edge
objects.description_zh: 半人马战行者以猛烈的力量进行近战攻击，对目标周围单位和自身造成伤害。将基于力量值造成额外伤害。此技能无法用于自杀。
objects.description_en: Centaur strikes a mighty blow at melee range, damaging both himself and a small area around the target. Deals extra damage based on your strength. Centaur cannot die from Double Edge.
notes_zh: 双刃剑对目标和自身都造成魔法伤害。

shard.zh: 双刃剑可以对敌人造成减速，并且每击中一名英雄都会暂时提升半人马战行者的力量值。每次叠加都会刷新持续时间，最多叠加%shard_max_stacks%次。
shard.en: Causes Double Edge to slow enemy heroes and increase Centaur's strength per hero hit for a short time. Duration refreshes per stack, up to a max of %shard_max_stacks% stacks.

objects.subject: centaur_return
objects.description_zh: 半人马战行者向攻击他的单位发出反击。反弹固定伤害加上自身力量的一定百分比。对防御塔的伤害减半。
objects.description_en: Centaur counters all attacks, dealing damage back to the attacker. Returns a fixed amount plus a percentage of your strength. Deals half damage to towers.
notes_zh: 反伤会在受到攻击时触发。
反伤能对防御塔造成伤害。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

objects.subject: centaur_stampede
objects.name_zh: 半人马战行者·奔袭冲撞
objects.description_zh: 半人马战行者带领所有队友向胜利冲锋，所有友方英雄达到极限移动速度，并使踩到的敌人减速。每个敌人只会受到一次踩踏作用，并受到基于半人马战行者力量值的伤害。
objects.description_en: Centaur leads all allies into a vicious charge causing them to move through units at max speed and slow any enemy units they trample. Trampled enemies take damage based on Centaur Warrunner's strength. Each enemy can be trampled once.

objects.subject: magnataur_shockwave
objects.description_zh: 马格纳斯放出一道能量波，对一条直线上的敌方单位造成伤害，并将他们朝自身牵引，同时受到短暂减速效果。
objects.description_en: Magnus sends out a wave of force, damaging enemy units in a line, pulling them towards him, and slowing them for a brief period.

objects.subject: magnataur_empower
objects.description_zh:
对友军施放时，给予攻击力加成并使其获得分裂效果。

授予力量总是在马格纳斯身上生效，拥有%self_multiplier%%%额外效果。
objects.description_en:
When cast on an ally, grants them bonus damage and cleave on attack. 

 Empower is always on Magnus with %self_multiplier%%% larger bonus.
notes_zh: 攻击力加成根据基础攻击力和主属性加成计算。
分裂伤害无视减益免疫。
远程单位的攻击没有分裂效果。

objects.subject: magnataur_skewer
objects.description_zh: 马格纳斯向前冲刺，用他巨大的犀角将敌人挑起。被击中的英雄将被拽至终点，然后受到伤害并且移动速度被减缓。根据行进的距离伤害也会提升。
objects.description_en: Magnus rushes forward, goring enemy units on his massive tusk. Heroes hit on the way will be dragged to the destination, then damaged and affected by slowed movement speed. The damage is increased based on distance traveled.
notes_zh: 马格纳斯受到眩晕、妖术或放逐作用时，巨角冲撞都会被打断。

shard.zh: 提升距离，并且使敌人穿过树木和高台时造成额外伤害。
shard.en: Increases range and deals additional damage when skewering enemies into trees or cliffs.

objects.subject: magnataur_horn_toss
objects.description_zh: 马格纳斯顶起前方的敌人，将其甩在身后。敌人受到伤害，滞空%air_duration%秒并处于眩晕状态，而且落地后还会眩晕一段时间。
objects.description_en: Magnus tosses any enemies in front of him, launching them to his rear. Enemies take damage, spend %air_duration% seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.

objects.subject: magnataur_solid_core
objects.description_zh: 马格纳斯的减速抗性得到提升，并且受到敌人技能和物品的击退效果减少。
objects.description_en: Magnus has increased slow resistance and suffers less knockback from enemy's abilities and items.

objects.subject: magnataur_reverse_polarity
objects.description_zh: 马格纳斯改变物质的属性，将附近的敌人拖拽至他的前方，并且以震击对他们造成伤害和眩晕。
objects.description_en: Magnus changes properties of matter, pulling all nearby enemies in front of him and stunning them with a damaging slam.

objects.subject: shredder_whirling_death
objects.description_zh: 伐木机使极其锋利的刀刃飞旋，对敌人造成伤害并摧毁他周围的树木。如果敌方英雄受到了作用，他的主属性将在短时间内降低少许。如果该技能施放过程中砍倒了树木则会根据砍倒的数量造成额外伤害。
objects.description_en: Timbersaw whirls extremely sharp edges, damaging enemies and destroying trees around him in an area. If an enemy hero is affected, it loses some of its primary attribute for a short duration. Whirling Death will deal bonus damage per tree destroyed.
